# order-configuration-ui-mockup-step3-4.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup.
**Source context:** `# Description` section, illustrating Step3
(delivery address, shipping, phone number) and Step4 (order summary) of
the order capture flow.

Two linked panels:

1. **Step3** — three grouped sub-forms: "Your Fiber Access Delivery
   Address" (street "avenue des Etats-Unis" 12, postcode 75012, city
   Paris, with "Validate Delivery Address"); "Your Box Shipping Options"
   (Standard Shipping 48-72h selected, free, with "Shipping Address =
   Access Delivery Address" checked, plus "Declare a New Address" and
   "Validate Shipping"); "Your Phone Number" (a masked French mobile
   number format selected, with "Validate Selection").
2. **Step4** — "Your Order - New Fiber Contract Silver" order summary:
   Fiber Access Standard (Basic Speed, 12,00€/month) plus the delivery
   address, installation fees (33,00€), Fix Communication Service
   (14,40€/month) with the phone number, TV Channels (Basic,
   6,00€/month), Box 1 (Strawberry Red, Maxi Storage, 6,00€/month),
   Standard Shipping (free, same delivery address), a running total
   (38,40€/month before discount, -6,00€/month welcome discount for 10
   months, 32,40€/month total, plus 33,00€ for the first month), and a
   "Confirm Your Order" action.
